svg.text: Fig. 1 — Tape-to-stick sorting station, plan view (1 px = 1 mm)
base plate ~860 × 500 mm · operator side at bottom · enclosure with ionizer and HEPA lid not shown
wafer table X–Y ±70 mm, θ ±3° — moves the frame so die i sits over the FIXED pick point
• ejector + tape-vacuum anvil below the tape
• down-looking camera above (die find, ID, chip check)
• gripper head: Z 60 mm, end-face jaws, jaw axis ∥ die X
grip ring: tape locked after ~10 % radial expansion → streets ≈ 1 mm
stick deck — 4 sticks: pass / fail / regrade / spare
stick ≈ 16 × 105 mm, 14 pockets at 7.5 mm pitch, DataMatrix on the end
UV cure box (offline, frame cured before mounting)
flow: UV cure → mount + expand frame → table brings die i under the head → ejector raises die →
jaws grip the end-face middles → head places the die on stick ledges → wafer map ⇒ stick map (ID, orientation)
